event.desc: Executed (wusiṭa) in al-Ramla in Dhū al-Ḥijja 878 for killing the mamluks of al-Zaynī al-Ustādār (al-Zayn Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qibṭī, #AIND-D10263). The Sultan did not accept from him and his companions the payment of 1,000 dinars as blood money to the victims' heirs, due to his great wickedness and the harm caused to Muslims by him.
event.note: His death in Dhū al-Ḥijja 878 H is directly linked to these events.

person.note: アクバーイ・アッ＝ザーヒリー・フシュカダム。アル＝アクナスとして知られる。ザイニー・アル＝ウスタダール（ザイン・ヤフヤー・イブン・アブドゥッラッザーク・アル＝クブティー、#AIND-D10263）のマムルークたちを殺害したため、ヒジュラ暦878年ズー・アル＝ヒッジャ月にラムラで（腰から切断する刑により）処刑された。スルタンは彼と彼の仲間からの千ディナールの血の賠償金の支払いを、彼の甚だしい悪行とムスリムへの害悪を理由に拒否した。

Aqbāy al-Ẓāhirī Khushqadam, known as al-Aqnaṣ. He was executed (wusiṭa) in al-Ramla in Dhū al-Ḥijja of the year 878 H for killing the mamluks of al-Zaynī al-Ustādār (al-Zayn Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qibṭī, #AIND-D10263). The Sultan did not accept from him and his companions the payment of a thousand dinars to those entitled to blood money, due to his great wickedness and the harm caused to Muslims by him.
